author: Kusha N M
raw:
ಸಾಧನೆಯ ಪಥದಲ್ಲಿ ಏಳುಬೀಳಿರಬೇಕು
ಬೋಧನೆಗೆ ಅರ್ಹವಹು ಅನುಭವದ ಕಥನ
ಶೋಧಿಸುವ ಜನರಿಹರು ಸವಾಲುಗಳನೊಡ್ಡಿ
ಸಾಧಿಸುವ ಛಲಬೇಕು ಮೂಢಮನುಜ

lines: On the road of achievement there must be rises and falls;
the story of experience is what makes one fit to teach;
there are people who will test you with challenges;
you need the grit to achieve, O deluded one.
en.bhavartha: Success is never a straight line. Experience, with its falls, is what qualifies us to guide others. When people challenge us, determination carries us through.
